name: e-biblia
description: E-Biblia – Étude Biblique Moderne & Assistant IA

scripts.postinstall: npm run prepare:bible-data && npm run build:css
scripts.sync: npm run prepare:bible-data && npm run build:css && npx cap sync android
scripts.open:android: npm run prepare:bible-data && npm run build:css && npx cap open android
scripts.build:android: npm run prepare:bible-data && npm run build:css && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
